title: MGDA seed0 frozen 8k-to-12k learning-curve evaluation
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The unconstrained six-objective MGDA seed0 continuation from 8k to 12k improves matched cross-anchor reward enough to justify replication despite a known, bounded 1.87-point increase in Standard10-boundary disagreement.
material_change: No training. Freeze and compare the immutable seed0 treatment 8k checkpoint against its exact six-objective 12k continuation control on 1,024 wholly new mirrored pairs per three anchors. Recompute both checkpoints on the existing outcome-blind 6,144-state panel and verify lineage/hashes.
baseline: Seed0 six-objective MGDA improved from +6.449 at 4k to +15.604 at 8k relative to ordinary control. Its 8k Standard10 agreement was 98.32%; the already-audited 12k control agreement is 96.45%. The seventh-objective alternative is rejected.
source: Frozen 8k parent SHA de70dd34 and six-objective 12k continuation SHA 7831a754.
notes: Admission to seed1 8k-to-12k replication requires later-minus-earlier pooled >0, >=2/3 anchors positive, Standard10 >=0, both seats >=0, exact lineage/hashes, 12k Standard10 greedy agreement >=95%, 8k-to-12k disagreement growth <=2 percentage points, and cap <=0.25. CI may cross zero at this internal dose. Failure holds six-objective scaling at 8k rather than treating small-scale absolute performance as a benchmark verdict.

Independent raw recomputation confirmed 3,072 matched pairs / 12,288 hands, SHA d50168f876445228428d05c231af3d68371efef058f715a74f2d9c1d41c9ed85, pooled +21.758301 bb/100 and 95% CI [4.758520,38.758081]. This internal paired CI excludes zero but is not Slumbot evidence.

result.summary: On wholly new common decks, the frozen six-objective MGDA 12k continuation beat its exact 8k parent by pooled +21.758 bb/100 CI[4.759,38.758]. All anchors improved (Standard10 +28.467, Slumbot-free +31.339, CFR96 +5.469) and both seats improved. Standard10 greedy agreement remained 96.45%; disagreement grew 1.872 points, within the preregistered 2-point bound.
result.conclusion: For seed0, unconstrained MGDA continued to learn from 8k to 12k with broad, statistically positive internal paired improvement, despite controlled source-boundary movement. This contradicts a premature small-dose rejection and justifies only an exact seed1 continuation replication before further scaling.
result.next_step: Resume seed1 from its exact frozen 8k MGDA checkpoint and Adam for one fresh 4,096-hand six-objective continuation, then evaluate 8k versus 12k on new common decks and the same preservation panel. Require multi-seed direction before scaling beyond 12k.
